name: Intraday Scalp
description: LONG ONLY momentum scalps on 15-minute charts with Supertrend direction filter and ADX chop filter. Targets liquid TSX large-caps in play with confirmed catalyst and volume surge. Requires confirmation candle before entry.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks in play today breaking news earnings releases analyst upgrades sector catalysts liquid large-cap mid-cap high relative volume active day trading names with confirmed price movement gap-up candidates strong buyer pressure
ta_focus: LONG ONLY — do NOT recommend SHORT positions. VWAP holds on 15m with EMA 9/21 bullish stack, Supertrend green confirming intraday bias, ADX > 20 confirming directional move not chop, RSI 50-65 momentum zone (reject if RSI > 70 overbought), MACD positive histogram on 15m, volume 2x+ average on entry candle. CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: Do NOT call BUY until a confirmation candle closes above VWAP with volume — identifying the setup is not enough, wait for the trigger candle. ATR-based stop sizing below VWAP or nearest EMA support.
trading_style: Intraday scalper, 15 min to 2 hour holds, LONG ONLY

name: EMA Stack Momentum Intraday
description: LONG ONLY 9/21/50 EMA stack with VWAP confirmation for intraday momentum entries on trending stocks. All three EMAs must be in bullish order above VWAP — this full-stack alignment is the primary quality filter. Requires confirmed breakout candle before BUY.
screening_prompt: TSX NASDAQ NYSE stocks in play today high relative volume morning momentum breaking out above pre-market highs VWAP hold confirmed bullish EMA alignment large-cap mid-cap liquid names with strong sector tailwinds buyer momentum
ta_focus: LONG ONLY — do NOT recommend SHORT positions. 9/21/50 EMA bullish stack alignment above VWAP, Supertrend green, RSI 50-70 momentum zone (reject if RSI > 75), MACD histogram expanding, Williams %R not yet overbought (above -20 = reject). CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: Only call BUY after a candle closes above all 3 EMAs with volume >= 1.5x average. If price is still approaching the stack or has not confirmed, use WATCH with the specific breakout level as entry_price. Do NOT front-run the breakout.
trading_style: Intraday momentum, 15-min to 2-hour holds, LONG ONLY

name: Opening Range Breakout
description: LONG ONLY breakouts above the first 30-minute opening range with volume surge confirmation. Best-performing strategy in audit (40% WR, +4.31% avg return). Requires confirmed close above ORH — do not front-run the breakout.
screening_prompt: TSX NYSE NASDAQ stocks with catalysts today earnings analyst upgrades sector news pre-market volume spikes liquid stocks with clean 30-minute opening range formation high beta names with strong upward directional momentum gap-up candidates
ta_focus: LONG ONLY — do NOT recommend SHORT positions. 30-minute opening range high (ORH) is the key breakout level. CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: Only call BUY after price closes a candle ABOVE ORH with volume >= 2x 20-day average. Before that confirmation, use WATCH with ORH as the entry_price trigger. Supertrend must be green and price above VWAP. RSI 55-68 on breakout candle (reject if RSI > 72 — chasing). ATR-based stop placed just below ORH level. If price breaks ORH but immediately reverses back below on the same candle (wick rejection), that is NOT confirmation — use NO_TRADE.
trading_style: Intraday breakout, 30-min to 3-hour holds, LONG ONLY

name: VWAP Reversal Scalp
description: LONG ONLY high-precision VWAP bounce scalp with Supertrend direction filter and Williams %R for oversold timing. Targets liquid large-caps. Requires confirmed reversal candle at VWAP before entry — do not anticipate the bounce.
screening_prompt: TSX large-cap stocks with clean VWAP levels today high daily volume market leaders in strong sectors liquid names pulling back toward VWAP in uptrend confirmed institutional buying activity dip-buy candidates
ta_focus: LONG ONLY — do NOT recommend SHORT positions. VWAP pullback bounce long ONLY. Supertrend must be green confirming daily bias is bullish. Williams %R must be below -80 (oversold) for entry timing. CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: Only call BUY after a green reversal candle closes at or above VWAP with the pullback showing decreasing volume (sellers exhausted) and the reversal candle showing increasing volume (buyers stepping in). If price is still falling toward VWAP without a reversal candle, use WATCH. MACD histogram must be positive or flattening on the reversal. Stop below VWAP or nearest EMA support.
trading_style: Intraday VWAP bounce scalper, 15-min to 90-min holds, LONG ONLY

name: Crypto Swing
description: LONG ONLY swing trade crypto assets with strong momentum and on-chain metrics. Full EMA 9/21/50/200 stack with Supertrend and Bollinger Bands for AI chart reading. 3-month momentum filter to avoid dead assets. Requires confirmed daily candle above breakout level.
screening_prompt: cryptocurrencies strong momentum growing on-chain activity active addresses TVL growth developer activity protocol upgrades social buzz top 100 market cap EMA golden cross forming bullish trend confirmed
ta_focus: LONG ONLY — do NOT recommend SHORT positions. EMA 50/200 golden cross or bullish stack, Supertrend green on daily, RSI 50-70 momentum zone (reject if RSI > 75 overbought), MACD histogram positive and expanding, Bollinger Bands widening on breakout, volume above 20-day average on up days, ATR expanding indicating trend acceleration. CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: Only call BUY after a daily candle closes above the breakout level with volume confirmation. If the setup is forming but not confirmed, use WATCH with the breakout level as entry_price.
trading_style: Crypto swing trader, 3-14 day holds, LONG ONLY

name: Crypto Intraday Scalp
description: LONG ONLY short-term crypto scalps on 15-minute charts with VWAP and Supertrend for direction, Williams %R for entry timing. Targets top-50 crypto with deep liquidity and confirmed intraday momentum. Requires confirmation candle.
screening_prompt: cryptocurrencies trending today high 24-hour volume breaking news token unlocks exchange listings viral social activity top 50 market cap deep liquidity major exchanges intraday momentum confirmed bullish
ta_focus: LONG ONLY — do NOT recommend SHORT positions. VWAP holds on 15m chart with Supertrend green, Williams %R oversold bounce below -75 for long entries, RSI 45-65 momentum continuation zone (reject if RSI > 70), EMA 9 > 21 bullish micro-stack, MACD positive histogram on 15m, volume surge 2x+ on entry candle. CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: Only call BUY after a green candle closes above VWAP with volume >= 2x average. If Williams %R is oversold but no reversal candle yet, use WATCH. ATR-based stops.
trading_style: Crypto intraday scalper, 15 min to 2 hour holds, LONG ONLY
